caption:
3 moves that actually lower your tax. Pick one, pick all three.

1. Salary sacrifice to super. Money goes into super before PAYG tax is calculated. Taxed at 15% — not your marginal rate. If you're on 30%, that's a 15% saving on every dollar you sacrifice.

2. Work from home — 70c per hour (2026–27 fixed rate). No receipts needed for individual home expenses. Just log your actual hours. Multiply by 70c. Claim it.

3. Work-related tools under $300. Buy a tool, piece of equipment or other work item that costs $300 or less? Claim the full cost immediately — no depreciation schedule.

All legal. All available to employees.

Save this.

General info only, not personal advice.
